entries.title: Arcane Phase
entries.body:
# Arcane Phase

## Overview
Arcane Phase is one of the most dangerous techniques taught within the Spellblade Orders, allowing the practitioner to partially convert their physical body into raw arcane energy. For a brief moment, the Spellblade exists between the physical and magical planes, enabling them to move through obstacles that would otherwise halt their advance.

While phased, the Spellblade's body becomes intangible to most physical matter. Stone walls, iron bars, enemy warriors, and difficult terrain become little more than passing obstacles. However, this transformation comes at a great risk. By becoming living mana, the Spellblade becomes significantly more vulnerable to hostile magic, as spells can interact directly with their unstable arcane form.

Masters repeatedly warn their apprentices that Arcane Phase is a technique of precision, not recklessness. Countless Spellblades have suffered horrific injuries by allowing the technique to expire while still inside solid matter. Those who master Arcane Phase always know exactly where they intend to return before they ever step beyond the physical world.

## Rank 1
### Description

Arcane Phase is one of the most dangerous techniques taught within the Spellblade Orders, allowing the practitioner to partially convert their physical body into raw arcane energy. For a brief moment, the Spellblade exists between the physical and magical planes, enabling them to move through obstacles that would otherwise halt their advance.

While phased, the Spellblade's body becomes intangible to most physical matter. Stone walls, iron bars, enemy warriors, and difficult terrain become little more than passing obstacles. However, this transformation comes at a great risk. By becoming living mana, the Spellblade becomes significantly more vulnerable to hostile magic, as spells can interact directly with their unstable arcane form.

Masters repeatedly warn their apprentices that Arcane Phase is a technique of precision, not recklessness. Countless Spellblades have suffered horrific injuries by allowing the technique to expire while still inside solid matter. Those who master Arcane Phase always know exactly where they intend to return before they ever step beyond the physical world.

### Effects

- Spend **1 Action Point** and **40 MP** to activate **Arcane Phase**.
- Arcane Phase lasts for **1 Turn**.
- **1 Use per Short Rest.**
- While Arcane Phase is active:
  - Ignore difficult terrain.
  - Move through creatures.
  - Move through thin, non-magical solid objects such as doors, gates, bars and walls.
  - You are immune to Opportunity Attacks.
  - You cannot interact with or manipulate physical objects while phased unless the GM determines otherwise.

#### Arcane Vulnerability

While Arcane Phase is active:

- You have **Disadvantage on Saving Throws against magical effects.**
- You take **25% additional magical damage** (rounded up).

#### ⚠ Phase Instability

Arcane Phase **must not** end while any part of your body occupies a creature or solid object.

If this occurs:

- You are immediately expelled to the nearest unoccupied space.
- You are **Knocked Prone**.
- You suffer **6d6 Arcane Damage**.
- You gain **Arcane Fatigue** until the end of your next turn.

### Lore

Among the Spellblade Orders, Arcane Phase is considered both a marvel and a warning. It represents the ultimate trust between a Spellblade and their mana, requiring absolute confidence that one's body can safely return to the physical world. Those who hesitate often discover too late that the arcane currents show little mercy to careless practitioners.

Veteran masters insist that Arcane Phase should never be viewed as an escape. It is a calculated commitment, demanding complete awareness of one's surroundings before taking even a single step beyond reality. Every apprentice is taught the same lesson before learning the technique: always know where you intend to reappear.

Legends speak of master Spellblades walking unharmed through castle walls, collapsing caverns, and enemy battle lines. Yet those same stories always end with a reminder that even the greatest masters respected the dangers of the technique, for the arcane realm rewards discipline and punishes arrogance in equal measure.

> *"The world will gladly let you pass through it... but it may not welcome you back if you choose your path poorly."*

> — Grand Spellblade Aetherion Lux, First Blade of the Infinite Well

## Rank 2
### Description

The Spellblade's control over Arcane Phase has improved, allowing them to maintain their incorporeal form for longer without destabilising their mana. What was once a brief step between worlds becomes a sustained state, enabling the Spellblade to navigate dangerous terrain and bypass physical obstacles with greater confidence.

Although the technique has become more stable, it remains one of the most hazardous abilities within the Spellblade arsenal. While partially transformed into arcane energy, the Spellblade becomes increasingly susceptible to hostile magic. Enemy spellcasters quickly learn to exploit this vulnerability, making careful timing and battlefield awareness essential.

Experienced Spellblades are taught that Arcane Phase should never be used recklessly. A poorly planned phase can leave them trapped between solid objects or exposed to devastating magical attacks. Every use demands discipline, patience, and absolute awareness of one's surroundings.

### Effects

- Spend **1 Action Point** and **35 MP** to activate **Arcane Phase**.
- Arcane Phase lasts for **2 Turns**.
- **2 Uses per Short Rest.**
- While Arcane Phase is active:
  - Ignore difficult terrain.
  - Move through creatures.
  - Move through non-magical doors, gates, walls, bars and other solid objects up to **1 metre thick**.
  - You are immune to Opportunity Attacks.
  - You cannot interact with or manipulate physical objects while phased unless the GM determines otherwise.

#### Arcane Vulnerability

While Arcane Phase is active:

- You have **Disadvantage on Saving Throws against magical effects.**
- You take **25% additional magical damage** (rounded up).

#### ⚠ Phase Instability

Arcane Phase **must not** end while any part of your body occupies a creature or solid object.

If this occurs:

- You are immediately expelled to the nearest unoccupied space.
- You are **Knocked Prone**.
- You suffer **6d6 Arcane Damage**.
- You gain **Arcane Fatigue** until the end of your next turn.

### Lore

Within the Spellblade Orders, Rank II is known as the **Ghost Step**, marking the point where the practitioner begins to trust the flow of mana rather than fear it. Remaining phased for several moments requires exceptional concentration, as even the slightest lapse can cause the arcane currents to become unstable.

Veteran instructors often send apprentices through abandoned ruins and ancient fortresses to teach them a simple lesson: always know where you intend to emerge. Many overconfident students have found themselves painfully expelled from stone walls after losing track of time, a mistake that every Spellblade remembers only once.

Those who master Rank II learn that Arcane Phase is not simply a means of movement. It is a lesson in restraint, precision, and respect for the unpredictable nature of arcane energy.

> *"The greatest danger is not stepping beyond the world—it is forgetting that the world still expects you to return."*

> — Grand Spellblade Aetherion Lux, First Blade of the Infinite Well

## Rank 3
### Description

The Spellblade has reached a level of mastery where Arcane Phase is no longer a desperate gamble, but a calculated manipulation of the boundary between the physical and arcane realms. Maintaining an incorporeal form has become second nature, allowing the Spellblade to traverse obstacles and hostile battlefields with remarkable precision.

While phased, the Spellblade exists only partially within the physical world. Weapons, creatures, and solid terrain struggle to impede their movement, making them exceptionally difficult to pin down. However, this freedom comes at a significant cost. Their body, now composed largely of unstable arcane energy, becomes increasingly vulnerable to hostile spells and magical effects capable of disrupting their fragile form.

Spellblade Masters teach that Rank III is where overconfidence claims the lives of many practitioners. The longer one remains phased, the easier it is to forget the dangers of the physical world waiting to reclaim them. Every experienced Spellblade knows that the greatest threat is not entering the arcane state—it is returning from it safely.

### Effects

- Spend **1 Action Point** and **30 MP** to activate **Arcane Phase**.
- Arcane Phase lasts for **3 Turns**.
- **3 Uses per Short Rest.**
- While Arcane Phase is active:
  - Ignore difficult terrain.
  - Move through creatures.
  - Move through most non-magical structures and natural obstacles, including walls, floors, ceilings, doors, gates, and large rock formations up to **2 metres thick**.
  - You are immune to Opportunity Attacks.
  - You cannot interact with or manipulate physical objects while phased unless the GM determines otherwise.

#### Arcane Vulnerability

While Arcane Phase is active:

- You have **Disadvantage on Saving Throws against magical effects.**
- You take **25% additional magical damage** (rounded up).

#### ⚠ Phase Instability

Arcane Phase **must not** end while any part of your body occupies a creature or solid object.

If this occurs:

- You are immediately expelled to the nearest unoccupied space.
- You are **Knocked Prone**.
- You suffer **8d6 Arcane Damage**.
- You gain **Arcane Fatigue** until the end of your next turn.

### Lore

Within the Spellblade Orders, Rank III is known as the **Veil Walker**, a title earned by those capable of walking confidently between the material world and the arcane currents that surround it. At this stage, Arcane Phase ceases to be viewed as a simple movement technique and becomes an expression of complete trust in one's mastery over mana.

Veterans often recount stories of Spellblades slipping effortlessly through fortress walls, collapsing caverns, and enemy shield lines before reappearing exactly where they intended. Yet every tale is accompanied by another, warning of those who misjudged a wall's thickness, underestimated the duration of the technique, or ignored the presence of enemy mages. The arcane realm is unforgiving to those who become complacent.

Masters remind every student that Arcane Phase does not make them invincible. It merely changes the dangers they face. Wisdom lies in knowing not only when to phase, but when to return.

> *"Any fool can step beyond the world. Only a master knows exactly where to step back into it."*

> — Grand Spellblade Aetherion Lux, First Blade of the Infinite Well

## Rank 4
### Description

The Spellblade has become a true master of Arcane Phase, effortlessly shifting between the physical world and the arcane plane. Their body now exists only loosely within reality, allowing them to bypass obstacles that even powerful magic was designed to stop. Walls, fortifications, and many magical barriers become little more than temporary inconveniences to a practitioner of this calibre.

Yet with such mastery comes even greater danger. While their connection to the physical world weakens, their arcane form becomes increasingly exposed to hostile magical forces. Enemy spellcasters can exploit this vulnerability, making every use of Arcane Phase a calculated risk rather than a guaranteed escape.

Within the Spellblade Orders, Rank IV is considered the threshold of true mastery. It is said that a master no longer asks whether a path exists—they simply decide to walk through it. Even so, the oldest instructors continually warn that arrogance has claimed more lives than any blade ever has.

### Effects

- Spend **1 Action Point** and **25 MP** to activate **Arcane Phase**.
- Arcane Phase lasts for **4 Turns**.
- **4 Uses per Short Rest.**
- While Arcane Phase is active:
  - Ignore difficult terrain.
  - Move through creatures.
  - Move through most non-magical structures regardless of thickness, provided your movement is sufficient to completely pass through them.
  - You may pass through **lesser magical barriers**, magical walls, force effects, and magically sealed doorways at the GM's discretion.
  - You are immune to Opportunity Attacks.
  - You cannot interact with or manipulate physical objects while phased unless the GM determines otherwise.

#### Arcane Vulnerability

While Arcane Phase is active:

- You have **Disadvantage on Saving Throws against magical effects.**
- You take **25% additional magical damage** (rounded up).

#### ⚠ Phase Instability

Arcane Phase **must not** end while any part of your body occupies a creature or solid object.

If this occurs:

- You are immediately expelled to the nearest unoccupied space.
- You are **Knocked Prone**.
- You suffer **10d6 Arcane Damage**.
- You gain **Arcane Fatigue** until the end of your next turn.

### Lore

Within the ancient Spellblade Orders, Rank IV is known as the **Veil Master**. Very few practitioners ever reach this stage, for it demands absolute trust in one's mastery over both body and mana. Those who succeed no longer view walls or barriers as obstacles, but as temporary boundaries between one step and the next.

Stories tell of Veil Masters infiltrating heavily fortified castles without opening a single gate, escaping collapsing temples by walking through solid stone, and pursuing enemies through magically sealed chambers thought to be impenetrable. Such feats have earned them equal measures of admiration and fear throughout Asteria.

Even so, every master shares the same warning with their apprentices: the arcane plane is unforgiving. A moment of carelessness, a lapse in concentration, or a misjudged path can turn Arcane Phase from a miraculous technique into a fatal mistake.

> *"Stone yields to patience. Magic yields to understanding. Pride yields to neither."*

> — Grand Spellblade Aetherion Lux, First Blade of the Infinite Well

## Rank 5
### Description

Arcane Phase reaches its ultimate form, allowing the Spellblade to exist almost entirely as living arcane energy. Through absolute mastery of their mana core, they freely shift between the material world and the Arcane Plane, slipping through obstacles that would stop even the greatest warriors. To onlookers, the Spellblade appears to fade from reality itself, moving effortlessly through walls, fortifications, creatures, and magical barriers before reforming exactly where they intend.

Despite this mastery, Arcane Phase remains one of the most dangerous techniques ever created. While the Spellblade is incredibly difficult for physical forces to hinder, they become exceptionally vulnerable to hostile magic. Every spell threatens to destabilise their arcane form, and the greatest enemy of a master Spellblade is often overconfidence.

The oldest masters teach that Arcane Phase is not an escape from reality—it is a temporary surrender to it. The world will always reclaim those who linger too long beyond its grasp.

### Effects

- Spend **1 Action Point** and **20 MP** to activate **Arcane Phase**.
- Arcane Phase lasts for **5 Turns**.
- **5 Uses per Short Rest.**
- While Arcane Phase is active:
  - Ignore difficult terrain.
  - Move freely through creatures.
  - Move through all non-magical structures regardless of thickness, provided your movement is sufficient to completely pass through them.
  - Move through nearly all magical barriers, force effects, magical walls, and magically sealed structures.
  - **Artifact-grade wards, Divine Magic, and World Magic cannot be phased through unless the GM rules otherwise.**
  - You are immune to Opportunity Attacks.
  - You cannot interact with or manipulate physical objects while phased unless the GM determines otherwise.

#### Arcane Vulnerability

While Arcane Phase is active:

- You have **Disadvantage on Saving Throws against magical effects.**
- You take **25% additional magical damage** (rounded up).

#### ⚠ Phase Instability

Arcane Phase **must never** end while any part of your body occupies a creature or solid object.

If this occurs:

- You are immediately expelled to the nearest unoccupied space.
- You are **Knocked Prone**.
- You suffer **12d6 Arcane Damage**.
- You gain **Arcane Fatigue** until the end of your next turn.
- The GM may apply additional consequences if you attempted to phase through an object or barrier beyond your current mastery.

### Lore

Within the oldest Spellblade Orders, Rank V is known as the **Phantom Ascendant**, a title granted only to those who have mastered the impossible. These legendary warriors no longer perceive walls, fortifications, or magical prisons as barriers. Instead, they see them as temporary imperfections within the fabric of reality, capable of being crossed through perfect harmony with the arcane.

Legends tell of Phantom Ascendants walking unhindered through impregnable citadels, escaping collapsing mountains, and crossing battlefields untouched by volleys of arrows. Yet every tale carries the same warning. Those who forget that they remain bound by the laws of reality inevitably discover that the Arcane Plane shows no mercy to the careless.

To master Arcane Phase is to accept that immense power always demands equal responsibility. A true Spellblade knows that the greatest danger is never the wall before them, but the decision of where they choose to return.

> *"Reality is not your enemy. It is your destination. Never forget to return to it."*

> — Grand Spellblade Aetherion Lux, First Blade of the Infinite Well

## Prerequisites
None

## Scaling
See individual rank details.

## Synergy
Information coming soon.

## GM Notes
GM-only information coming soon.

entries.title: Bladestorm
entries.body:
# Bladestorm

## Overview
Bladestorm is one of the most demanding martial techniques taught within the Spellblade Orders. Rather than relying upon destructive magic, the Spellblade channels a small amount of mana through their body to enhance their speed, allowing them to unleash a rapid succession of perfectly controlled strikes in the time most warriors make a single attack.

The technique demands immense physical endurance. Every muscle is pushed to its limit as the Spellblade flows from one strike to the next with blinding speed. To onlookers, the blade appears to split into shimmering afterimages as steel flashes through the air, leaving enemies struggling to defend against the relentless assault.

At Rank I, Bladestorm is still a taxing technique that can only be sustained for a brief moment. Even so, a skilled Spellblade can overwhelm an opponent's guard or pressure multiple nearby enemies before they have time to react.

## Rank 1
### Description

Bladestorm is one of the most demanding martial techniques taught within the Spellblade Orders. Rather than relying upon destructive magic, the Spellblade channels a small amount of mana through their body to enhance their speed, allowing them to unleash a rapid succession of perfectly controlled strikes in the time most warriors make a single attack.

The technique demands immense physical endurance. Every muscle is pushed to its limit as the Spellblade flows from one strike to the next with blinding speed. To onlookers, the blade appears to split into shimmering afterimages as steel flashes through the air, leaving enemies struggling to defend against the relentless assault.

At Rank I, Bladestorm is still a taxing technique that can only be sustained for a brief moment. Even so, a skilled Spellblade can overwhelm an opponent's guard or pressure multiple nearby enemies before they have time to react.

### Effects

- Spend **1 Action Point**, **5 MP**, and **25 SP** to activate **Bladestorm**.
- Immediately make **2 melee weapon attacks**.
- You may direct both attacks against **one creature**, or split them between **two different creatures** within your weapon's reach.
- Resolve each attack separately using your normal Weapon Attack Roll.
- Each successful attack deals **normal weapon damage**, including any applicable weapon enchantments or active Spellblade talents.
- Bladestorm counts as a single Attack Action.
- This talent cannot be used with ranged weapons.

### Lore

Within the Spellblade Orders, Bladestorm is regarded as a test of martial discipline rather than magical ability. Apprentices quickly discover that speed alone is meaningless without precision, and that every unnecessary movement wastes valuable stamina.

Masters often teach that the technique should resemble the calm eye of a storm rather than uncontrolled fury. Every strike is deliberate, every movement efficient, and every breath measured. Only through absolute control can a Spellblade unleash a true Bladestorm without exhausting themselves.

Those who witness the technique often describe it as though several swords were striking at once, unable to follow the impossible speed of the Spellblade's blade.

> *"A single strike may win a duel. A storm of strikes wins the battle before your enemy can answer."*

> — Grand Spellblade Aetherion Lux, First Blade of the Infinite Well

## Rank 2
### Description

The Spellblade's mastery of Bladestorm continues to develop, allowing them to unleash an even greater flurry of attacks without sacrificing precision. Their body has adapted to the immense physical strain, enabling each strike to flow seamlessly into the next while maintaining complete control over their weapon.

Rather than relying on brute force, the Spellblade embraces momentum. Every swing naturally carries into another, creating a relentless assault that overwhelms an opponent's ability to defend. To those witnessing the technique, the Spellblade appears surrounded by a whirlwind of flashing steel, each strike arriving before the last has fully finished.

At Rank II, Bladestorm becomes a feared battlefield technique capable of pressuring multiple enemies or relentlessly driving a single opponent onto the defensive. Though physically exhausting, experienced Spellblades understand that a perfectly timed Bladestorm can end a battle before their enemy has the opportunity to recover.

### Effects

- Spend **1 Action Point**, **5 MP**, and **30 SP** to activate **Bladestorm**.
- Immediately make **3 melee weapon attacks**.
- You may direct the attacks against **one creature**, or divide them among **multiple creatures** within your weapon's reach.
- Resolve each attack separately using your normal Weapon Attack Roll.
- Each successful attack deals **normal weapon damage**, including any applicable weapon enchantments or active Spellblade talents.
- Bladestorm counts as a single Attack Action.
- This talent cannot be used with ranged weapons.
- This rank replaces the effects of **Bladestorm — Rank I**.

### Lore

Within the Spellblade Orders, Rank II is known as the **Raging Tempest**. Apprentices who achieve this milestone have learned that Bladestorm is not about attacking wildly, but about maintaining perfect control while striking with extraordinary speed.

Masters often compare the technique to a violent storm sweeping across the battlefield. Each strike appears independent, yet every movement is connected through flawless timing and discipline. Opponents quickly discover that attempting to defend against one strike only leaves them exposed to the next.

To veteran Spellblades, Bladestorm is more than a display of martial skill—it is proof that disciplined technique will always surpass reckless aggression.

> *"The untrained swing harder. The master simply strikes more often than the eye can follow."*

> — Grand Spellblade Aetherion Lux, First Blade of the Infinite Well

## Rank 3
### Description

The Spellblade has mastered the rhythm of Bladestorm, transforming it into a devastating display of speed and martial precision. Every movement flows effortlessly into the next as mana subtly reinforces the body, allowing the Spellblade to push beyond normal physical limits without relying upon destructive magic.

To observers, the technique resembles a raging storm of flashing steel. The Spellblade seems to appear in several places at once, delivering a relentless sequence of perfectly controlled strikes that leaves opponents with little opportunity to defend themselves. Every swing is deliberate, every step measured, and every strike contributes to an overwhelming offensive rhythm.

At Rank III, Bladestorm has become one of the defining techniques of the Spellblade. Whether facing a single powerful foe or several nearby enemies, the Spellblade can unleash a barrage of attacks capable of shifting the momentum of battle in an instant.

### Effects

- Spend **1 Action Point**, **5 MP**, and **35 SP** to activate **Bladestorm**.
- Immediately make **4 melee weapon attacks**.
- You may direct the attacks against **one creature**, or divide them among **multiple creatures** within your weapon's reach.
- Resolve each attack separately using your normal Weapon Attack Roll.
- Each successful attack deals **normal weapon damage**, including any applicable weapon enchantments and active Spellblade talents.
- Bladestorm counts as a single Attack Action.
- This talent cannot be used with ranged weapons.
- This rank replaces the effects of **Bladestorm — Rank II**.

### Lore

Among the Spellblade Orders, Rank III is known as the **Tempest Dance**. It is the point where speed and discipline become inseparable, allowing the practitioner to unleash a continuous flurry of strikes while maintaining flawless technique.

Masters teach that Bladestorm is never about losing control. A true Spellblade remains calm within the chaos, allowing every movement to naturally guide the next. Those who rely on reckless speed quickly exhaust themselves, while those who embrace precision become an unstoppable force upon the battlefield.

Veteran warriors often recognise a master of Bladestorm before the first strike lands, for the silence before the storm is every bit as terrifying as the storm itself.

> *"Speed without discipline is merely panic. A true storm strikes with purpose."*

> — Grand Spellblade Aetherion Lux, First Blade of the Infinite Well

## Rank 4
### Description

The Spellblade has pushed Bladestorm beyond mortal swordsmanship, achieving a level of speed and precision that few warriors can comprehend. Every movement flows without hesitation, each strike naturally leading into the next as the Spellblade maintains complete control over the storm they unleash. Only a small amount of mana is required to reinforce the body, while sheer martial discipline drives the technique forward.

To those caught within its reach, Bladestorm becomes a relentless barrage of flashing steel. Opponents struggle to react as strike after strike falls from seemingly every direction, forcing even veteran warriors onto the defensive. Despite the incredible speed, every blow remains measured and deliberate, reflecting years of relentless training.

At Rank IV, the Spellblade can overwhelm groups of enemies or relentlessly pressure a powerful foe with a storm of perfectly executed attacks. Few can withstand the assault once the storm has begun.

### Effects

- Spend **1 Action Point**, **5 MP**, and **40 SP** to activate **Bladestorm**.
- Immediately make **5 melee weapon attacks**.
- You may direct the attacks against **one creature**, or divide them among **multiple creatures** within your weapon's reach.
- Resolve each attack separately using your normal Weapon Attack Roll.
- Each successful attack deals **normal weapon damage**, including any applicable weapon enchantments and active Spellblade talents.
- Bladestorm counts as a single Attack Action.
- This talent cannot be used with ranged weapons.
- This rank replaces the effects of **Bladestorm — Rank III**.

### Lore

Within the Spellblade Orders, Rank IV is known as the **Eye of the Storm**. It represents the point where the practitioner no longer forces the technique through sheer effort. Instead, they become the calm centre of the storm, allowing flawless discipline to guide every strike while chaos erupts around them.

Veteran masters teach that Bladestorm is not won through speed alone. Every strike must carry intent, every movement must preserve balance, and every breath must maintain the rhythm that defines the Spellblade. Those who lose themselves within the storm become reckless; those who master it become legends.

Stories of Rank IV practitioners speak of battlefields where enemies believed they faced an entire company, only to discover it was a single Spellblade moving faster than the eye could follow.

> *"Become the calm within the storm, and your enemies will remember only the sound of your blade."*

> — Grand Spellblade Aetherion Lux, First Blade of the Infinite Well

## Rank 5
### Description

Bladestorm reaches its ultimate expression, becoming the pinnacle of martial mastery within the Spellblade Orders. The Spellblade no longer thinks about each individual strike; body, blade, and instinct move as one, unleashing a relentless torrent of perfectly executed attacks that few opponents can hope to withstand. Only a faint pulse of mana is required to reinforce the body, while years of discipline and physical conditioning drive the technique beyond mortal limits.

To onlookers, the Spellblade appears as a storm of flashing steel. Their weapon becomes a blur, striking with such speed that enemies struggle to determine where one attack ends and the next begins. Every movement is efficient, every step deliberate, and every strike delivered with unwavering precision.

Only the greatest Spellblades ever achieve this level of mastery. A master of Bladestorm can dominate the space around them, carving through multiple foes or unleashing an overwhelming assault upon a single enemy before they have the opportunity to respond.

### Effects

- Spend **1 Action Point**, **5 MP**, and **45 SP** to activate **Bladestorm**.
- Immediately make **6 melee weapon attacks**.
- You may direct the attacks against **one creature**, or divide them among **multiple creatures** within your weapon's reach.
- Resolve each attack separately using your normal Weapon Attack Roll.
- Each successful attack deals **normal weapon damage**, including any applicable weapon enchantments and active Spellblade talents.
- Bladestorm counts as a single Attack Action.
- This talent cannot be used with ranged weapons.
- This rank replaces the effects of **Bladestorm — Rank IV**.

### Lore

Within the oldest Spellblade Orders, Rank V is known as the **Endless Storm**. It is a technique so demanding that only the greatest masters are capable of wielding it without collapsing from exhaustion. Every strike flows effortlessly into the next, creating a flawless sequence of attacks that embodies the perfect union of martial discipline and arcane enhancement.

Legends tell of Spellblades who stood alone against overwhelming numbers, their blades moving with such impossible speed that survivors believed they had faced an entire company rather than a single warrior. Whether these stories have grown through centuries of retelling is unknown, but every apprentice dreams of one day reaching the Endless Storm.

To master Bladestorm is to prove that the greatest weapon of a Spellblade is not magic, but the discipline to wield both steel and mana in absolute harmony.

> *"A storm does not ask how many stand before it. It simply sweeps across the battlefield until nothing remains in its path."*

> — Grand Spellblade Aetherion Lux, First Blade of the Infinite Well

## Prerequisites
None

See individual rank details.

## GM Notes
GM-only information coming soon.

entries.body:
# Mystic Recovery

## Overview
Mystic Recovery teaches the Spellblade that health, stamina, and mana are not separate energies, but different expressions of the same life force. Through careful control of their mana core, a Spellblade can sacrifice one resource to restore another, allowing them to adapt to the ever-changing demands of battle.

At Rank I, the conversion process is crude and highly inefficient. Much of the energy is lost during the transmutation, requiring the Spellblade to sacrifice far more than they recover. Even so, experienced warriors understand that surviving a battle often depends upon having the right resource available at the right moment, regardless of the cost.

In addition to active transmutation, the Spellblade's growing understanding of their own life force naturally accelerates their recovery while resting, allowing their body and mana to replenish more efficiently between encounters.

## Rank 1
### Description

Mystic Recovery teaches the Spellblade that health, stamina, and mana are not separate energies, but different expressions of the same life force. Through careful control of their mana core, a Spellblade can sacrifice one resource to restore another, allowing them to adapt to the ever-changing demands of battle.

At Rank I, the conversion process is crude and highly inefficient. Much of the energy is lost during the transmutation, requiring the Spellblade to sacrifice far more than they recover. Even so, experienced warriors understand that surviving a battle often depends upon having the right resource available at the right moment, regardless of the cost.

In addition to active transmutation, the Spellblade's growing understanding of their own life force naturally accelerates their recovery while resting, allowing their body and mana to replenish more efficiently between encounters.

### Effects

#### Active

- Spend **1 Action Point** to activate **Mystic Recovery**.
- Instantly perform **one** of the following conversions using a **3:1 ratio**:
  - Spend **3 HP** to restore **1 MP**.
  - Spend **3 MP** to restore **1 SP**.
  - Spend **3 SP** to restore **1 HP**.
- Mystic Recovery may only be used **once per turn**.
- Restored resources cannot exceed their maximum values.
- This talent cannot reduce your HP below **1**.

#### Passive

- Increase your natural **Health, Mana, and Stamina regeneration by 10%** while resting outside of combat.

### Lore

Among the Spellblade Orders, Mystic Recovery is considered one of the first lessons in mastering the body's internal energies. Apprentices are taught that mana, stamina, and life are connected by a single current, and that with sufficient discipline, one form of energy can be transformed into another.

The process is imperfect at first, often leaving the practitioner drained after each conversion. However, every successful transmutation strengthens their understanding of this delicate balance, laying the foundation for far greater mastery in the years to come.

Veteran Spellblades often remind their students that Mystic Recovery is not a technique of abundance, but one of sacrifice. Victory belongs to those willing to give up what they have in order to preserve what they need most.

> *"Strength is not measured by what you possess, but by what you are willing to sacrifice to keep fighting."*

> — Grand Spellblade Aetherion Lux, First Blade of the Infinite Well

## Rank 2
### Description

The Spellblade's understanding of internal energy has grown considerably, allowing them to perform resource transmutation with far greater efficiency. By strengthening the connection between their mana core, physical endurance, and life force, they reduce the amount of energy lost during each conversion.

While the process still requires sacrifice, experienced Spellblades learn to redirect energy with greater precision, making Mystic Recovery a dependable technique during prolonged battles. Whether restoring precious mana to continue casting, recovering stamina to maintain relentless attacks, or converting excess stamina into life, the Spellblade gains greater control over their own survival.

As their mastery improves, the Spellblade's body also becomes more efficient at recovering naturally. Even while resting, their internal energies continue to rebalance themselves, allowing them to recover faster than ordinary warriors or mages.

### Effects

#### Active

- Spend **1 Action Point** to activate **Mystic Recovery**.
- Instantly perform **one** of the following conversions using a **2:1 ratio**:
  - Spend **2 HP** to restore **1 MP**.
  - Spend **2 MP** to restore **1 SP**.
  - Spend **2 SP** to restore **1 HP**.
- Mystic Recovery may only be used **once per turn**.
- Restored resources cannot exceed their maximum values.
- This talent cannot reduce your HP below **1**.

#### Passive

- Increase your natural **Health, Mana, and Stamina regeneration by 20%** while resting outside of combat.

### Lore

Within the Spellblade Orders, Rank II is known as the **Balanced Exchange**. Apprentices have moved beyond crude transmutation, learning instead to guide energy with careful precision rather than brute force. Every successful conversion strengthens the connection between body, mind, and soul.

Masters teach that Mystic Recovery is not merely a survival technique—it is an exercise in discipline. A Spellblade who understands when to sacrifice one resource for another can remain effective long after others have exhausted their strength.

Many veteran Spellblades credit this technique with saving their lives during long campaigns, where careful management of their own life force often proved more valuable than any potion or enchanted relic.

> *"Energy is never truly lost. The wise simply learn how to guide it where it is needed most."*

> — Grand Spellblade Aetherion Lux, First Blade of the Infinite Well

## Rank 3
### Description

The Spellblade has mastered the balance between body, mind, and mana, achieving perfect harmony over the three fundamental energies that sustain all life. No longer wasting energy during transmutation, they can redirect their internal reserves with flawless precision, allowing them to adapt instantly to the demands of battle.

At Rank III, Mystic Recovery reaches perfect efficiency. Every resource sacrificed is converted without loss, enabling the Spellblade to replenish exactly what they require in the heat of combat. Whether restoring mana to unleash another spell, replenishing stamina to continue an assault, or converting stamina into vital health, every exchange becomes a calculated decision rather than a desperate gamble.

This mastery also strengthens the Spellblade's natural recovery. Their body instinctively restores itself during periods of rest, allowing them to return to battle sooner than most warriors or spellcasters.

### Effects

#### Active

- Spend **1 Action Point** to activate **Mystic Recovery**.
- Instantly perform **one** of the following conversions using a **1:1 ratio**:
  - Spend **1 HP** to restore **1 MP**.
  - Spend **1 MP** to restore **1 SP**.
  - Spend **1 SP** to restore **1 HP**.
- Mystic Recovery may only be used **once per turn**.
- Restored resources cannot exceed their maximum values.
- This talent cannot reduce your HP below **1**.

#### Passive

- Increase your natural **Health, Mana, and Stamina regeneration by 30%** while resting outside of combat.

### Lore

Within the Spellblade Orders, Rank III is known as the **Perfect Exchange**. It is the stage where apprentices become true masters of internal transmutation, no longer sacrificing excess energy during the conversion process. Every movement of mana, every breath, and every heartbeat become part of a perfectly balanced cycle.

Veteran instructors often describe Mystic Recovery as the art of understanding that no energy is ever truly created or destroyed. A disciplined Spellblade merely guides it to where it is needed most, maintaining harmony between body and soul even amidst the chaos of battle.

Those who achieve this level of mastery are respected throughout the Orders, for they have proven that true strength lies not in possessing endless power, but in using every fragment of it with perfect efficiency.

> *"The moment nothing is wasted, every breath becomes a source of strength."*

> — Grand Spellblade Aetherion Lux, First Blade of the Infinite Well

## Rank 4
### Description

The Spellblade's mastery over internal transmutation has surpassed perfect balance, allowing them to amplify the energy released during each conversion. Through absolute control of their mana core, they have learned to minimise waste and harness ambient arcane energy, producing greater returns than the energy originally sacrificed.

At Rank IV, Mystic Recovery no longer serves merely as a means of survival—it becomes a powerful tool for maintaining momentum throughout extended battles. A skilled Spellblade can rapidly adapt to changing circumstances, converting the resource they possess into the one they require most with remarkable efficiency.

The constant refinement of this technique also strengthens the Spellblade's natural vitality. Their body, mind, and mana recover in harmony during rest, ensuring they return to battle sooner and in far better condition than most warriors or mages.

### Effects

#### Active

- Spend **1 Action Point** to activate **Mystic Recovery**.
- Instantly perform **one** of the following conversions using a **1:2 ratio**:
  - Spend **1 HP** to restore **2 MP**.
  - Spend **1 MP** to restore **2 SP**.
  - Spend **1 SP** to restore **2 HP**.
- Mystic Recovery may only be used **once per turn**.
- Restored resources cannot exceed their maximum values.
- This talent cannot reduce your HP below **1**.

#### Passive

- Increase your natural **Health, Mana, and Stamina regeneration by 40%** while resting outside of combat.

### Lore

Among the greatest Spellblade Orders, Rank IV is known as the **Abundant Exchange**. At this stage, the practitioner has moved beyond simply conserving energy—they have learned to draw upon the natural arcane currents surrounding all living things, allowing each conversion to yield greater results than would otherwise be possible.

Masters caution that this is not the creation of energy from nothing. Instead, it is the result of flawless efficiency, discipline, and an intimate understanding of the world's arcane flow. To outsiders it appears miraculous, but to a Spellblade it is simply another expression of balance.

Veterans often say that a master of Mystic Recovery no longer fears exhaustion, for they have learned to transform every remaining reserve into exactly what the battle demands.

> *"The world is filled with untapped strength. Master yourself first, and the currents of mana will do the rest."*

> — Grand Spellblade Aetherion Lux, First Blade of the Infinite Well

## Rank 5
### Description

Mystic Recovery reaches its ultimate expression as the Spellblade becomes a true master of internal transmutation. Their body, mind, and mana core exist in complete harmony, allowing energy to flow effortlessly between health, stamina, and mana with extraordinary efficiency. Every conversion is no longer a desperate sacrifice, but a deliberate manipulation of the life force that binds all things.

At Rank V, the Spellblade is capable of amplifying every exchange through flawless control of ambient mana. By drawing upon the natural arcane currents surrounding them, they recover far more than they expend, making Mystic Recovery one of the defining techniques of the Order. Even in the longest battles, a master Spellblade can adapt to changing circumstances, ensuring the resource they need is always within reach.

Combined with their exceptional natural regeneration, the Spellblade becomes remarkably self-sufficient. Though never immortal, they possess an endurance that few warriors or spellcasters can hope to match.

### Effects

#### Active

- Spend **1 Action Point** to activate **Mystic Recovery**.
- Instantly perform **one** of the following conversions using a **1:3 ratio**:
  - Spend **1 HP** to restore **3 MP**.
  - Spend **1 MP** to restore **3 SP**.
  - Spend **1 SP** to restore **3 HP**.
- Mystic Recovery may only be used **once per turn**.
- Restored resources cannot exceed their maximum values.
- This talent cannot reduce your HP below **1**.

#### Passive

- Increase your natural **Health, Mana, and Stamina regeneration by 50%** while resting outside of combat.

### Lore

Within the oldest Spellblade Orders, Rank V is known as the **Perfect Cycle**, representing absolute mastery over the three pillars of life: body, spirit, and mana. Those who achieve this level no longer think of health, stamina, and mana as separate resources. To them, they are simply different forms of the same energy, endlessly flowing and changing with purpose.

Legends tell of masters who fought for days without collapsing, continually redirecting their strength to meet the demands of battle. While others exhausted themselves through reckless expenditure, these Spellblades maintained an elegant balance, always possessing exactly what they needed when they needed it most.

To master Mystic Recovery is to embody one of the oldest teachings of the Spellblade: true power is not measured by how much energy you possess, but by how perfectly you can command its flow.

> *"The river never fears running dry, for it understands that every current returns. Become the current, and your strength shall never truly leave you."*

> — Grand Spellblade Aetherion Lux, First Blade of the Infinite Well

## Prerequisites
None

GM-only information coming soon.

entries.body:
# Spellbreaker

## Overview
Spellbreaker is one of the most revered techniques practiced by the Spellblade Orders, allowing a warrior to challenge hostile magic with nothing more than steel, mana, and unwavering resolve. Rather than avoiding incoming spells, the Spellblade steps forward, channeling arcane energy through their weapon to sever the spell before it can reach its intended target.

Executing the technique demands exceptional timing and concentration. The Spellblade must accurately read the flow of mana within an incoming spell and strike at precisely the right moment. A perfectly timed cut causes the spell's magical structure to collapse, dispersing its energy harmlessly into the air. However, hesitation or poor judgement can leave the Spellblade fully exposed to the attack, while a catastrophic mistake may cause the unstable mana to erupt against its would-be defender.

At Rank I, only the simplest travelling spells can be intercepted, making Spellbreaker a difficult but immensely rewarding technique for those willing to master its risks.

## Rank 1
### Description

Spellbreaker is one of the most revered techniques practiced by the Spellblade Orders, allowing a warrior to challenge hostile magic with nothing more than steel, mana, and unwavering resolve. Rather than avoiding incoming spells, the Spellblade steps forward, channeling arcane energy through their weapon to sever the spell before it can reach its intended target.

Executing the technique demands exceptional timing and concentration. The Spellblade must accurately read the flow of mana within an incoming spell and strike at precisely the right moment. A perfectly timed cut causes the spell's magical structure to collapse, dispersing its energy harmlessly into the air. However, hesitation or poor judgement can leave the Spellblade fully exposed to the attack, while a catastrophic mistake may cause the unstable mana to erupt against its would-be defender.

At Rank I, only the simplest travelling spells can be intercepted, making Spellbreaker a difficult but immensely rewarding technique for those willing to master its risks.

### Effects

- Spend **1 Action Point** and **20 MP** to activate **Spellbreaker**.
- You may only target **hostile travelling magical effects** that pass within your weapon's reach (such as bolts, lances, spears, beams, or magical projectiles).
- Make a **Weapon Attack Roll** against the Spellbreak DC.

#### Spellbreak DC

| Spell Rank | DC |
|------------|---:|
| Cantrip | 14 |
| Weak | 16 |
| Minor | 18 |

#### Results

- **Success:** The spell is severed and immediately dissipates, causing no effect.
- **Failure:** The spell continues normally and resolves against its target.
- **Natural 1 – Arcane Rebound:** The spell continues normally. You suffer an additional **1d8 Arcane Damage**, lose **10 MP**, and suffer any secondary elemental effects the spell would normally inflict, if applicable.

### Lore

Within the Spellblade Orders, Spellbreaker is regarded as the first true test of mastery. Apprentices spend countless hours studying the structure of magic, learning that every spell possesses a fragile core where its mana is held together. Finding that weakness in the heartbeat before impact is what separates a Spellblade from an ordinary warrior.

Many never master the technique. Some hesitate, allowing the spell to pass unhindered, while others strike too soon or too late and suffer the violent backlash of unstable mana. Those who succeed, however, become legends—warriors capable of standing before a charging fireball or lightning spear with complete confidence, trusting only in the edge of their blade.

> *"A Spellblade does not fear magic. They simply teach it where to break."*

> — Grand Spellblade Aetherion Lux, First Blade of the Infinite Well

## Rank 2
### Description

Having mastered the fundamentals of Spellbreaker, the Spellblade learns to read the flow of increasingly complex magic. The intricate weave of hostile spells becomes clearer to the trained eye, allowing the Spellblade to identify weaknesses within their structure and strike with greater confidence.

The technique remains dangerous, but experience has refined the Spellblade's judgement. Their weapon moves with unwavering precision, intercepting hostile magic at the precise moment before its arcane structure stabilises. Every successful Spellbreak is a testament to discipline, timing, and an intimate understanding of the forces that shape magic itself.

At Rank II, the Spellblade is capable of challenging **Greater Spells**, proving that even advanced magic can be overcome through skill rather than overwhelming power.

### Effects

- Spend **1 Action Point** and **25 MP** to activate **Spellbreaker**.
- You may only target **hostile travelling magical effects** that pass within your weapon's reach (such as bolts, lances, spears, beams, or magical projectiles).
- Make a **Weapon Attack Roll** against the Spellbreak DC.

#### Spellbreak DC

| Spell Rank | DC |
|------------|---:|
| Cantrip | 12 |
| Weak | 14 |
| Minor | 16 |
| Greater | 20 |

#### Results

- **Success:** The spell is severed and immediately dissipates, causing no effect.
- **Failure:** The spell continues normally and resolves against its target.
- **Natural 1 – Arcane Rebound:** The spell continues normally. You suffer an additional **1d10 Arcane Damage**, lose **15 MP**, and suffer any secondary elemental effects the spell would normally inflict, if applicable.

### Lore

Within the Spellblade Orders, Rank II is known as the **Mage's Challenge**, for it marks the point where a Spellblade begins confronting the more devastating spells wielded by experienced mages. What once seemed impossible gradually becomes achievable as instinct and experience replace hesitation.

Veteran instructors remind their students that Spellbreaker is not an act of brute strength. It is a demonstration of absolute precision. The blade does not overpower the spell—it finds the single weakness holding the magic together and exploits it before the spell reaches its target.

Many accomplished Spellblades earn their reputation through this technique alone, becoming warriors whose mere presence forces enemy spellcasters to think twice before unleashing their strongest attacks.

> *"Every spell has a flaw. Your task is not to create it, but to find it before the spell finds you."*

> — Grand Spellblade Aetherion Lux, First Blade of the Infinite Well

## Rank 3
### Description

Spellbreaker has become an instinctive technique, allowing the Spellblade to challenge powerful magic with confidence and precision. Years of training have taught them to recognise the arcane threads that bind a spell together, revealing fleeting weaknesses invisible to ordinary spellcasters. Every successful Spellbreak is a demonstration of complete control over both weapon and mana.

The Spellblade no longer waits for magic to strike—they meet it head-on. Their blade becomes an instrument capable of severing spells before they fully manifest, dispersing the unstable mana into harmless fragments. Even powerful magic can be undone when the strike lands with perfect timing.

At Rank III, the Spellblade is capable of confronting **Strengthened Spells**, a feat few warriors would dare attempt. Although the risk of failure remains, experienced Spellblades know that a single decisive strike can completely alter the outcome of a battle.

### Effects

- Spend **1 Action Point** and **30 MP** to activate **Spellbreaker**.
- You may only target **hostile travelling magical effects** that pass within your weapon's reach (such as bolts, lances, spears, beams, or magical projectiles).
- Make a **Weapon Attack Roll** against the Spellbreak DC.

#### Spellbreak DC

| Spell Rank | DC |
|------------|---:|
| Cantrip | 10 |
| Weak | 12 |
| Minor | 14 |
| Greater | 18 |
| Strengthened | 22 |

#### Results

- **Success:** The spell is severed and immediately dissipates, causing no effect.
- **Failure:** The spell continues normally and resolves against its target.
- **Natural 1 – Arcane Rebound:** The spell continues normally. You suffer an additional **1d12 Arcane Damage**, lose **20 MP**, and suffer any secondary elemental effects the spell would normally inflict, if applicable.

### Lore

Among the Spellblade Orders, Rank III is known as the **Spell Hunter's Edge**. It marks the point where a Spellblade ceases to merely defend against magic and begins actively challenging the greatest spellcasters on equal footing.

Masters teach that every spell, no matter how complex, is built upon a foundation of carefully woven mana. A single perfectly placed strike is capable of unravelling that foundation, causing even formidable magic to collapse before reaching its target.

Legends tell of veteran Spellblades standing before volleys of enchanted projectiles, calmly cutting each one from the air before advancing through the fading arcane mist. Such feats are only possible through absolute discipline, flawless timing, and an unbreakable resolve.

> *"Power alone does not break a spell. Precision reveals the flaw, and courage strikes it."*

> — Grand Spellblade Aetherion Lux, First Blade of the Infinite Well

## Rank 4
### Description

The Spellblade has ascended into the ranks of the greatest mage hunters, capable of severing immensely powerful spells that would overwhelm most warriors. Years of relentless training have sharpened their understanding of arcane structure, allowing them to identify even the smallest instability within advanced magic.

To an observer, the technique appears effortless. The Spellblade calmly watches an incoming spell, waiting until the final heartbeat before impact before delivering a single precise strike. Rather than overpowering the spell through brute force, they cut through the delicate threads holding its mana together, causing the entire construct to collapse into harmless fragments.

At Rank IV, the Spellblade can challenge both **Enhanced** and **Superior Spells**, an achievement that places them among the elite of the Spellblade Orders. Enemy mages quickly learn that even their strongest attacks are no longer guaranteed to reach their target.

### Effects

- Spend **1 Action Point** and **35 MP** to activate **Spellbreaker**.
- You may only target **hostile travelling magical effects** that pass within your weapon's reach (such as bolts, lances, spears, beams, or magical projectiles).
- Make a **Weapon Attack Roll** against the Spellbreak DC.

#### Spellbreak DC

| Spell Rank | DC |
|------------|---:|
| Cantrip | 8 |
| Weak | 10 |
| Minor | 12 |
| Greater | 16 |
| Strengthened | 20 |
| Enhanced | 24 |
| Superior | 26 |

#### Results

- **Success:** The spell is severed and immediately dissipates, causing no effect.
- **Failure:** The spell continues normally and resolves against its target.
- **Natural 1 – Arcane Rebound:** The spell continues normally. You suffer an additional **2d8 Arcane Damage**, lose **25 MP**, and suffer any secondary elemental effects the spell would normally inflict, if applicable.

### Lore

Within the ancient Spellblade Orders, Rank IV is known as the **Mage's Bane**, a title bestowed upon warriors whose mastery allows them to stand before even the most accomplished spellcasters without fear. Their reputation is earned not through magical talent alone, but through their ability to deny magic itself.

Stories tell of Spellblades who marched through storms of arcane destruction, their blades flashing as spell after spell shattered into drifting motes of fading mana. To their allies, they appeared untouchable. To enemy mages, they became a nightmare that turned their greatest strength into uncertainty.

Masters teach that Spellbreaker is ultimately an act of understanding rather than destruction. Every spell possesses a weakness, and only those with absolute discipline can recognise it before the opportunity vanishes.

> *"A master does not ask whether a spell can be broken. They simply decide where to cut."*

> — Grand Spellblade Aetherion Lux, First Blade of the Infinite Well

## Rank 5
### Description

Spellbreaker reaches its ultimate form, allowing the Spellblade to challenge some of the most devastating magic known throughout Asteria. Years of unwavering discipline have taught the Spellblade that every spell, no matter how complex, is built upon a delicate framework of mana. At Rank V, they possess the knowledge and precision to find that weakness in an instant and shatter it with a single, perfectly timed strike.

The technique is no longer driven by instinct alone—it has become an art. The Spellblade calmly studies the approaching spell, waiting until the final moment before cutting through its arcane core. To those who witness it, the impossible becomes reality as torrents of magical energy are split apart and dissolved into harmless fragments before they ever reach their target.

Only the greatest Spellblades are capable of wielding Spellbreaker at this level. Their mastery inspires allies and strikes fear into enemy spellcasters, who know that even their strongest spells may be reduced to nothing by the edge of a single enchanted blade.

### Effects

- Spend **1 Action Point** and **40 MP** to activate **Spellbreaker**.
- You may only target **hostile travelling magical effects** that pass within your weapon's reach (such as bolts, lances, spears, beams, or magical projectiles).
- Make a **Weapon Attack Roll** against the Spellbreak DC.

#### Spellbreak DC

| Spell Rank | DC |
|------------|---:|
| Cantrip | 6 |
| Weak | 8 |
| Minor | 10 |
| Greater | 14 |
| Strengthened | 18 |
| Enhanced | 22 |
| Superior | 24 |
| Grand | 28 |
| World | Cannot be Spellbroken |

#### Results

- **Success:** The spell is severed and immediately dissipates, causing no effect.
- **Failure:** The spell continues normally and resolves against its target.
- **Natural 1 – Arcane Rebound:** The spell continues normally. You suffer **2d10 Arcane Damage**, lose **30 MP**, and suffer any secondary elemental effects the spell would normally inflict, if applicable.

- This rank replaces the effects of **Spellbreaker — Rank IV**.

### Lore

Within the oldest Spellblade Orders, Rank V is known as the **World Cleaver's Edge**. It is said that those who attain this mastery no longer see spells as overwhelming forces of destruction, but as intricate patterns of mana waiting to be unravelled. They understand that even the greatest magic possesses flaws—provided one has the courage and skill to strike them.

Legends speak of master Spellblades who stood before dragons, archmages, and ancient horrors, cutting apart torrents of magical destruction before pressing forward without hesitation. While even they cannot sever the reality-shaping power of **World Spells**, few other forms of magic remain beyond their reach.

To master Spellbreaker is to embody one of the oldest philosophies of the Spellblade Orders: magic is not an unstoppable force. Like steel, it can be studied, understood, and ultimately broken.

> *"Every spell has an ending. A master Spellblade simply chooses where it begins."*

> — Grand Spellblade Aetherion Lux, First Blade of the Infinite Well

## Prerequisites
None

## Scaling
See individual rank details.

## Synergy
Information coming soon.

## GM Notes
GM-only information coming soon.

entries.body:
# Arcane Arsenal

## Overview
Arcane Arsenal is one of the defining techniques of a true Spellblade. Rather than relying upon weapons forged by mortal hands, the Spellblade shapes their own mana into a physical weapon, forging an armament that perfectly reflects both their combat training and magical affinity. To a Spellblade, every weapon is simply another form their mana can assume.

When manifesting an Arcane Weapon, the Spellblade chooses both its physical form and magical affinity. Whether forging a blazing greatsword, a lightning-charged spear, a crystalline bow, or a blade of pure Arcane Mana, every creation is unique to its wielder. The weapon feels perfectly balanced, as though it were crafted specifically for the Spellblade's hand.

Although the technique appears effortless in the hands of a master, creating an Arcane Weapon requires remarkable control over mana. Every manifestation is a fusion of martial discipline and arcane precision, allowing the Spellblade to remain armed even when stripped of every physical possession.

## Rank 1
### Description

Arcane Arsenal is one of the defining techniques of a true Spellblade. Rather than relying upon weapons forged by mortal hands, the Spellblade shapes their own mana into a physical weapon, forging an armament that perfectly reflects both their combat training and magical affinity. To a Spellblade, every weapon is simply another form their mana can assume.

When manifesting an Arcane Weapon, the Spellblade chooses both its physical form and magical affinity. Whether forging a blazing greatsword, a lightning-charged spear, a crystalline bow, or a blade of pure Arcane Mana, every creation is unique to its wielder. The weapon feels perfectly balanced, as though it were crafted specifically for the Spellblade's hand.

Although the technique appears effortless in the hands of a master, creating an Arcane Weapon requires remarkable control over mana. Every manifestation is a fusion of martial discipline and arcane precision, allowing the Spellblade to remain armed even when stripped of every physical possession.

### Effects

- Spend **35 MP** and **1 Action Point** to manifest **one Arcane Weapon**.
- The Arcane Weapon lasts for **10 Minutes**, or until dismissed.
- You may only maintain **one Arcane Weapon** at a time.
- Choose **any weapon type** you are proficient with when the weapon is manifested.
- Choose one of your **known magical affinities** when the weapon is created. The weapon retains this affinity until it disappears.
- The Arcane Weapon counts as a **Magical Weapon**.
- The weapon deals its **normal weapon damage**, plus an additional **2d6** damage matching its chosen magical affinity.
- If disarmed, the Arcane Weapon immediately dissipates.
- Arcane Weapons cannot be traded, sold, permanently stored, or wielded by another creature.

### Lore

Within the oldest Spellblade Orders, Arcane Arsenal is regarded as the moment a student truly becomes self-sufficient. Masters teach that steel can dull, shatter, or be stolen, but knowledge cannot. A Spellblade who understands how to forge a weapon from mana will never truly stand unarmed.

Every Arcane Weapon bears traces of its creator's soul. Weapons forged from fire may glow with molten veins, while those shaped from lightning crackle with contained energy. Pure Arcane weapons shimmer like polished crystal, and no two manifestations are ever exactly alike. Veteran Spellblades are often recognised by the appearance of their Arsenal long before their names are spoken.

To wield Arcane Arsenal is to understand that true mastery is not measured by the weapons one owns, but by the ability to create the perfect weapon whenever it is needed.

> *"A warrior carries steel into battle. A Spellblade carries the knowledge to forge it from their own soul."*

> — Grand Spellblade Aetherion Lux, First Blade of the Infinite Well

## Rank 2
### Description

The Spellblade's control over Arcane Arsenal has matured, allowing their manifested weapons to remain stable for far longer while requiring less mana to sustain. Every Arcane Weapon now feels less like a temporary creation and more like a true extension of the Spellblade's body, responding instantly to every movement and intention.

With greater experience comes greater refinement. The Spellblade learns to weave intricate mana patterns throughout the weapon during its creation, strengthening its structure and allowing it to endure prolonged combat without losing cohesion. The chosen magical affinity burns brighter within the weapon, making every strike a seamless combination of martial skill and arcane power.

Although still limited to manifesting a single weapon, experienced Spellblades no longer fear being separated from their equipment. Their weapon can be recreated whenever needed, ensuring they are always prepared for whatever battle lies ahead.

### Effects

- Spend **30 MP** and **1 Action Point** to manifest **one Arcane Weapon**.
- The Arcane Weapon lasts for **20 Minutes**, or until dismissed.
- You may only maintain **one Arcane Weapon** at a time.
- Choose **any weapon type** you are proficient with when the weapon is manifested.
- Choose one of your **known magical affinities** when the weapon is created. The weapon retains this affinity until it disappears.
- The Arcane Weapon counts as a **Magical Weapon**.
- The weapon deals its **normal weapon damage**, plus an additional **2d6** damage matching its chosen magical affinity.
- Arcane Weapons created through this talent are considered exceptionally stable and cannot be destroyed by mundane means.
- If disarmed, the Arcane Weapon immediately dissipates.
- Arcane Weapons cannot be traded, sold, permanently stored, or wielded by another creature.
- This rank replaces the effects of **Arcane Arsenal — Rank I**.

### Lore

Among the Spellblade Orders, Rank II is known as the **Forgemaster's Grip**, marking the stage where a Spellblade no longer creates a weapon through effort alone. Instead, the weapon forms naturally in response to its wielder's will, flowing from raw mana into solid form with remarkable speed and precision.

Masters often challenge apprentices to dismiss and recreate their weapon repeatedly until the process becomes instinctive. They teach that hesitation in battle can be fatal, and that a true Spellblade should never worry about losing their weapon, only about choosing the right one for the moment.

Veteran Spellblades often become recognised by their Arcane Arsenal alone. Whether forged from radiant light, living flame, crackling lightning, or pure Arcane Mana, every weapon reflects the personality and discipline of its creator, making each manifestation as unique as the warrior who wields it.

> *"A forged blade is carried by its master. An Arcane Weapon is carried by its master's will."*

> — Grand Spellblade Aetherion Lux, First Blade of the Infinite Well

## Rank 3
### Description

Arcane Arsenal reaches a new level of mastery as the Spellblade learns that a weapon forged from mana is never fixed in form. Instead of dismissing and recreating their Arcane Weapon, the Spellblade can reshape it instantly into another weapon they have mastered, allowing them to adapt to the ever-changing flow of battle without interrupting their momentum.

Veteran Spellblades often transition seamlessly between weapons during combat. A longsword becomes a spear to engage a distant foe, a warhammer forms to crush heavy armour, or twin daggers become a greatsword in preparation for a decisive strike. To an outside observer, the weapon appears to dissolve into streams of mana before reforming almost instantly into its new shape.

This level of mastery marks the point where the Arcane Weapon truly becomes an extension of the Spellblade's will. The weapon no longer dictates the style of combat—the Spellblade simply creates the weapon that best suits the moment.

### Effects

- Spend **30 MP** and **1 Action Point** to manifest **one Arcane Weapon**.
- The Arcane Weapon lasts for **30 Minutes**, or until dismissed.
- You may only maintain **one Arcane Weapon** at a time.
- Choose **any weapon type** you are proficient with when the weapon is first manifested.
- Choose one of your **known magical affinities** when the weapon is created. The weapon retains this affinity until dismissed.
- The Arcane Weapon counts as a **Magical Weapon**.
- The weapon deals its **normal weapon damage**, plus an additional **3d6** damage matching its chosen magical affinity.
- **Once per turn**, you may spend **1 Action Point** to instantly reshape your Arcane Weapon into any other weapon you are proficient with without dismissing it. The weapon retains its chosen magical affinity.
- Arcane Weapons cannot be destroyed by mundane means.
- If disarmed, the Arcane Weapon immediately dissipates.
- Arcane Weapons cannot be traded, sold, permanently stored, or wielded by another creature.
- This rank replaces the effects of **Arcane Arsenal — Rank II**.

### Lore

Within the Spellblade Orders, Rank III is known as the **Living Arsenal**. Masters teach that no single weapon is perfect for every battle, and a true Spellblade should never be limited by the weapon they currently hold. Instead, they learn to view every weapon as merely another shape their mana can assume.

Watching a master of the Living Arsenal is a breathtaking display of martial artistry. Weapons shift effortlessly between strikes, each transformation occurring so fluidly that many enemies fail to realise the change until it is too late. Every form is deliberate, chosen to exploit an opening, counter an opponent's fighting style, or adapt to the changing battlefield.

To master the Living Arsenal is to abandon the idea of favourite weapons entirely. Every weapon becomes your weapon, and every battle becomes an opportunity to demonstrate complete mastery over both steel and mana.

> *"The greatest weapon is not the sword in your hand—it is the one you choose to create next."*

> — Grand Spellblade Aetherion Lux, First Blade of the Infinite Well

## Rank 4
### Description

The Spellblade has achieved a level of mastery where a single Arcane Weapon is no longer sufficient. Through exceptional control over their mana, they can now maintain multiple manifestations simultaneously, allowing them to wield paired weapons or combine offence and defence without sacrificing the stability of their creations.

Rather than simply increasing the power of their arsenal, the Spellblade expands its versatility. Twin blades flow together in perfect harmony, a spear and shield appear as one seamless creation, or an axe and dagger allow the Spellblade to adapt instantly to shifting battlefield conditions. Every manifestation remains an extension of the Spellblade's will, responding as naturally as their own limbs.

Among the Spellblade Orders, Rank IV represents complete confidence in one's martial abilities. Masters no longer think about the weapon they require—they simply will it into existence, knowing their Arcane Arsenal will always provide the perfect tool for the task.

### Effects

- Spend **25 MP** and **1 Action Point** to manifest your **Arcane Arsenal**.
- Your Arcane Arsenal lasts for **1 Hour**, or until dismissed.
- Your Arcane Weapons deal their **normal weapon damage**, plus an additional **3d6** damage matching their chosen magical affinity.
- Choose one of your **known magical affinities** when your Arcane Arsenal is manifested. All manifested weapons share this affinity until dismissed.
- Arcane Weapons count as **Magical Weapons**.

When manifesting your Arcane Arsenal, choose one of the following:

- **One Two-Handed Weapon.**
- **Two One-Handed Weapons.**
- **One One-Handed Weapon and one Arcane Shield.**

Additional Benefits:

- You may reshape any manifested weapon into another weapon you are proficient with by spending **1 Action Point**.
- The chosen magical affinity remains unchanged when reshaping.
- Arcane Weapons cannot be destroyed by mundane means.
- If disarmed, only the affected Arcane Weapon dissipates. Remaining manifested equipment is unaffected.
- Arcane Weapons cannot be traded, sold, permanently stored, or wielded by another creature.
- This rank replaces the effects of **Arcane Arsenal — Rank III**.

### Lore

Within the oldest Spellblade Orders, Rank IV is known as the **Master Arsenal**. Reaching this stage signifies that a Spellblade no longer sees weapons as individual tools, but as parts of a complete fighting style. Every weapon exists only as another expression of their mana, ready to be reshaped whenever the battle demands.

Veterans often demonstrate this mastery by flowing effortlessly between weapon combinations without ever breaking their rhythm. A sword becomes twin daggers, twin daggers become a spear, and moments later a shield forms beside them as though it had always existed. To an observer, the transformations appear less like magic and more like the weapon itself is alive.

The greatest masters teach that adaptability is the true strength of Arcane Arsenal. Victory belongs not to the warrior carrying the strongest weapon, but to the one capable of creating the perfect weapon for every challenge.

> *"An ordinary warrior masters a weapon. A Spellblade masters every weapon before the battle has even begun."*

> — Grand Spellblade Aetherion Lux, First Blade of the Infinite Well

## Rank 5
### Description

Arcane Arsenal reaches its ultimate expression, becoming the defining symbol of a true Spellblade Master. No longer bound by the limitations of conventional weapons, the Spellblade effortlessly shapes their mana into any weapon they have mastered, seamlessly adapting to every challenge without interrupting the flow of battle. Every manifestation is an extension of their body, mind, and soul, forged not from steel, but from absolute control over arcane energy.

At this level, the Arcane Arsenal no longer feels like a summoned weapon. It becomes a permanent companion while maintained, capable of shifting between countless forms without losing its magical affinity or structural integrity. Whether wielding twin blades, a towering greataxe, a spear and shield, or a finely crafted bow, the Spellblade is never without the perfect weapon for the moment.

Among the oldest Spellblade Orders, Rank V is known as the **Infinite Arsenal**. Masters believe this is the moment where the Spellblade transcends the idea of weapon mastery. They no longer wield weapons—they command them through will alone.

### Effects

- Spend **20 MP** and **1 Action Point** to manifest your **Arcane Arsenal**.
- Your Arcane Arsenal remains until **dismissed**, or until you become **Unconscious**.
- Your Arcane Weapons deal their **normal weapon damage**, plus an additional **3d6** damage matching their chosen magical affinity.
- Choose one of your **known magical affinities** when your Arcane Arsenal is manifested. All Arcane Weapons retain this affinity until dismissed.
- Arcane Weapons count as **Legendary Magical Weapons**.

When manifesting your Arcane Arsenal, you may choose:

- One Two-Handed Weapon.
- Two One-Handed Weapons.
- One One-Handed Weapon and one Arcane Shield.

#### Infinite Arsenal

- Once per turn, you may spend **1 Action Point** to instantly reshape any Arcane Weapon into another weapon you are proficient with.
- Reshaping does not dismiss the weapon or change its chosen magical affinity.
- Arcane Weapons cannot be destroyed by mundane means.
- If disarmed, only the affected Arcane Weapon dissipates and may be immediately recreated on your next turn.
- Arcane Weapons cannot be traded, sold, permanently stored, or wielded by another creature.

#### Weapon Mastery

Each manifested weapon gains an additional passive benefit based on its weapon type.

Examples include:

- **Sword** — +1 Weapon Attack Rolls.
- **Greatsword** — Reroll one weapon damage die once per attack.
- **Axe** — Critical Hits inflict **Bleeding**.
- **Warhammer** — Successful hits force a **Strength Saving Throw** or the target is **Knocked Prone**.
- **Spear** — Gain **+2 metres** weapon reach.
- **Bow** — Increased range and ignores **Half Cover**.
- **Arcane Shield** — Gain **+1 Armour** and Advantage against being **Disarmed**.

The GM may create additional mastery effects for other weapon types.

### Lore

Within the oldest Spellblade Orders, Rank V is spoken of only in legend. Those who achieve the Infinite Arsenal are said to possess perfect harmony between martial discipline and arcane mastery, creating weapons so flawless that they are often mistaken for relics forged by the gods themselves. Every weapon reflects the Spellblade's soul, carrying their chosen magical affinity in both form and function.

Masters of the Infinite Arsenal have been witnessed changing weapons in the blink of an eye, effortlessly adapting to every opponent and every battlefield. Enemies who prepare to face a swordsman suddenly find themselves duelling a spearman, while heavily armoured champions are met with crushing hammers moments later. To fight such a Spellblade is to face every weapon ever mastered by their Order.

The Infinite Arsenal is regarded as the pinnacle of weapon mastery. It teaches that true strength is never found within the weapon itself, but within the warrior capable of creating exactly what is needed at precisely the right moment.

> *"A king commands an army. A master Spellblade commands every weapon that army has ever carried."*

> — Grand Spellblade Aetherion Lux, First Blade of the Infinite Well
